name: app-registry-onlog-setloglevel
description: firebase/app onLog(cb) registers a global log handler (returning undefined) and setLogLevel('warn') raises the threshold; a subsequent malformed registerVersion() emits a warn entry through the SDK logger to the handler. Pins the observable register+emit contract: the entry carries a level, a type, a string message, and an args array. The probe clears its handler and restores the level afterwards.
